audit_member_text: [L300-L333] (LOW/resource-use) gridrotate_r3 creates and zeroes five full rank-3 automatic arrays for every call regardless of the selected variable, risking substantial stack use.

adversarial.rationale: Five full-sized temporaries impose genuine memory/work overhead, although only four are zeroed and alfazr3 is filled from alfaz.
